Contract preserved: only the three begin attributes were removed; element tree, text, ids, dur, targets, and all geometry are unchanged (geometryPreserved:true throughout). Latest real verifier: passed=true."}

{"kind":"final","text":"Done. The fault was that all three animateTransform elements had begin="indefinite", which prevented autostart (activeAnimations was empty).

Steps taken:
1. Read pelican.svg (sha256 2cb6272b…d80d8) and ran pelican.verify, which reproduced the fault: passed=false, failure=pelican_animation_not_started, activeAnimations=[] while expectedAnimations=[back-spin, front-spin, pedal-spin].
2. First preview attempt with a generic oldText was rejected as ambiguous (the same substring appears three times) — no write occurred.
3. Re-previewed with three unique, context-qualified edits (each including its distinct from/to coordinates) and confirmed exactly one match each.
4. Applied the patch, removing only begin="indefinite" from back-spin, front-spin, and pedal-spin so they use the SVG default begin (0s). New sha256 60459cf2…530147; byteLength 2566→2509.
5. Ran pelican.verify: passed=true, activeAnimations=[back-spin, front-spin, pedal-spin], moving wheel-back/wheel-front/pedal all changed=true, geometryPreserved=true, no errors/warnings.

All other attributes (dur, from/to, repeatCount, ids, targets) and the entire element tree/artwork were preserved; only the three begin attributes were removed."}
